Об игреToverblade is a magical deck-building strategy game. Train your heroes, explore a dangerous world, and overcome wolves, giants, and ice golems on your way to a mysterious fortress.

Features
• recruit knights, archers, and wizards 🧙

• collect various cards and alter your play style 🃏 

• over 90 different items to collect 🗡️

• over 30 enemies to encounter 👹

• 10 unique areas to explore ⛰️
